title: Establish Your Vision
coreMove: Draft a vision vivid enough to organize sacrifice and close enough to guide the next 12 week cycle.
sourcePressure: The chapter builds the long-range vision that gives the 12 week cycle direction and emotional force.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making vision a vague dream statement that has no power over tradeoffs or discomfort.

sourceAnchors.name: Impossible, Possible, Probable, Given
sourceAnchors.detail: The source sidecar verifies this phrase as a Chapter 13 subhead.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The vision has to move possibility down the ladder until a different future begins to feel claimable.

sourceAnchors.name: Team Visions
sourceAnchors.detail: The source sidecar verifies Team Visions as a Chapter 13 subhead.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A team vision matters only when people can see what shared sacrifice is buying.

hook: person staring at a laptop beside coffee
abstract definition before a concrete moment
the-12-week-year-ch13: do not open with a generic execution panic
counterintuition: The problem is not X but Y
Most people think X, but actually Y
It is not about working harder
the-12-week-year-ch13: avoid a neat discipline-versus-motivation reversal
tryThisNow: set a timer and journal about priorities
write three goals and circle one
ask yourself what matters most today
examples: generic manager in a conference room
commuter with headphones deciding to be disciplined
the-12-week-year-ch13: avoid repeated timestamp-name-action openings beyond two examples

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence

exampleSpecs.stakes: the visible result will slip while everyone can still explain the effort
